# Approach:
* try crs4326 
* Goal: a table that records % agriculture from the simulations (or summary statistics) for each UNIQUE_ID 

* STEP 1: Make individual rasters for each species Critical Habitat or range  (731 for CH and 1515 species total) for the CONUS that overlap with available land.
*** a) When overlayed the available land raster with the CH or range species rasters, needed to give the available land raster a value of -1000 or -2000, respectively so that later we could more easily get ride of any pixels that didn't contain a species or available land.  
*** b) these rasters are saved in a list of about 100 species rasters each and saved as *.rds files (an R file format).  
*** c) I coudn't combine much more than 100 species rasters together in a list as the object size would get too large for my computer memory.   

* Available land was generated by looking at the "action area" and subseting out the 4 following NLCD classes: 52 (shrub), 71 (grassland/herbaceous), 81 (pasture/hay), and 95 (emergent herbaceous wetlands).  

* STEP 2: Randomly select the 500,000 (or 100K) acres worth of 30 acre pixels and see which ones overlap with CH or Range and find out which species are most impacted.  
*** a) this step uses a similar random sampling loop as the other code that just looks at amount of land impacted, but modified to run each species separately and to save output such that we can look at the individual species impacts. 

* !!! Use Un-CONUS clipped areas for aquatic/ocean species when calculating percent of habitat??

* 348.4336 m for 30 acre grid = 121406 sq meters
* 3 acres = 12140.6 m2 = 110.1844 m * 110.1844 m 
* if Sample 3764000 acres with 30 acre grid size, 125467 30 acre pixel
* 267252377 acres of available land total/ 30 acre pixels = 8908413 pixels
* 15 acres = 246.3794 m pixel size. 

* Note: If the available land area is too small it is not converted to a 30 acre pixel using this method

* FWS: 220 CH and 1051 Range species
* NMFS: 18 CH and 31 Range species

* Available Land Raster at 3 acre pixel size = 137400722 pixels *3 acres = 412202166 acres

*  Atmos File Path: /home/mpennino/R
* range_dis = st_read('/home/mpennino/R/FWS_Range_CONUS_unique.shp')

* Former projection: states_sf <- st_transform(states_sf, CRS("+init=epsg:26978"))

* Area of Available Land without Protected Areas (domains 1-3): 219898686 acres

# Load states data
```{r}

CH_dir = 'D:/ArcGIS/Collaborations/2025_Critical_Habitat/'

library(sp)
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(mapview)
library(stars)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(clipr)
library(USA.state.boundaries)
library(fst)
library(units)

# states_sf =  us_states() # from USAboundaries package
# states_sf = st_as_sf(states_sf)
states_sf = st_as_sf(state_boundaries_wgs84)
states_sf <- st_transform(states_sf, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))
states_conus = states_sf[states_sf$NAME !='Alaska' &
                           states_sf$NAME !='Hawaii' & 
                           states_sf$NAME !="U.S. Virgin Islands" &
                           states_sf$NAME !='Puerto Rico' &
                           states_sf$TYPE == 'Land',]
states_boundary = st_union(states_conus)

#states_OR = states_conus[states_conus$NAME == 'Oregon',]
#states_AR = states_conus[states_conus$NAME == 'Arkansas',]

```

# Clip FWS Shapefiles to CONUS
```{r}

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transform coordinates
ch_fws. <- st_transform(ch_fws., CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))
rang1_fws. <- st_transform(range1, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))
rang2_fws. <- st_transform(range2, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))
#range_buff <- st_transform(range_buff, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))
ch_buff_full. <- st_transform(ch_buff_full, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))



#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clip out CONUS species
ch_fws = st_intersection(st_make_valid(ch_fws.),states_boundary)
rang1_fws = st_intersection(st_make_valid(rang1_fws.),states_boundary)
rang2_fws = st_intersection(st_make_valid(rang2_fws.),states_boundary)
range_buff. = st_intersection(st_make_valid(range_buff),states_boundary) # didn't work, not using this

ch_buff_clip = st_intersection(st_make_valid(ch_buff_full.),states_boundary)

dim(range_buff)
dim(range_buff.)

# Save
st_write(ch_fws, paste0(CH_dir,'FWS_crithab_all_layers/crithab_poly_CONUS2.shp'))
```

# Clip NMFS Shapefiles to CONUS
```{r}

names(NMF_CH_line_dis)[which(colnames(NMF_CH_line_dis)=="SCIENAME")] = "sciname"
names(NMF_CH_line_dis)[which(colnames(NMF_CH_line_dis)=="COMNAME")] = "comname"

names(NMF_CH_poly_dis)[which(colnames(NMF_CH_poly_dis)=="SCIENAME")] = "sciname"
names(NMF_CH_poly_dis)[which(colnames(NMF_CH_poly_dis)=="COMNAME")] = "comname"
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transform coordinates
NMF_CH_line_dis. <- st_transform(NMF_CH_line_dis, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))
NMF_CH_poly_dis. <- st_transform(NMF_CH_poly_dis, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))


#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clip out CONUS species
NMF_CH_line_dis. = st_intersection(st_make_valid(NMF_CH_line_dis.),states_boundary)
NMF_CH_poly_dis. = st_intersection(st_make_valid(NMF_CH_poly_dis.),states_boundary)


# Save
st_write(NMF_CH_line_dis., paste0(CH_dir,'NMFS/NMFS_CH_line_dissolved_CONUS.shp'))
st_write(NMF_CH_poly_dis., paste0(CH_dir,'NMFS/NMFS_CH_poly_dissolved_CONUS.shp'))

dim(test)
```

# Calc Pixel Area of Available Land
* For the 63 Crushing facilities: 31978761 acres of available land total/ 3 acre pixels = 10659587 pixels
* for Full AL dataset 267252377 acres of available land total/ 3 acre pixels = 89084126 pixels
```{r}

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For the 63 Crushing Facilities
al_r = as(al_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster

# make sure values for AL are all either 0 or -2000
al_r[al_r <0 ] <- -2000 


temp = getValues(al_r)
temp2 = data.frame(value = temp)
temp3 = as.data.frame(temp2[complete.cases(temp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
names(temp3)[1]= "value"
levels(factor(temp3$value))
sum(temp3$value<0) # 20092134 pixels
sum(temp3$value<0)*3 # 60276402 acres 

# % shapefile area of pixel area(shape area / pixel area)
100*31978761/60276402# 53.05353

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Full All 3 acre dataset

al_stars_full = readRDS(paste0(al_dir,'AvailableLand23_raster_3acre_Pixels_over15acrePatches_simp.rds'))
al_r = as(al_stars_full, "Raster") # stars to raster

# make sure values for AL are all either 0 or -2000
al_r[al_r <0 ] <- -2000 


temp = getValues(al_r)
temp2 = data.frame(value = temp)
temp3 = as.data.frame(temp2[complete.cases(temp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
names(temp3)[1]= "value"
levels(factor(temp3$value))
sum(temp3$value<0) # 111527135 pixels
sum(temp3$value<0)*3 # 334581405 acres 

# % shapefile area of pixel area (shape area / pixel area)
100*267252377/334581405# 79.87664
```

# Merge Areas FWS
```{r}

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Critical Habitat No Buffer
ch_df2 = ch_df %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres))
ch_all_df2 = ch_all_df %>% group_by(sciname) %>% 
  summarize(area_acres_full = sum(area_acres_full))

CH_AREAS = merge(ch_df2,ch_all_df2[,c('sciname','area_acres_full')],by='sciname')
CH_AREAS$DIFF = CH_AREAS$area_acres_full-CH_AREAS$area_acres

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Critical Habitat Buffer
ch_buff_df2 = ch_buff_df  %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres))
ch_buff_full_df2 = ch_buff_full_df %>% group_by(sciname) %>% 
  summarize(area_acres_full = sum(area_acres))

CH_buff_AREAS = merge(ch_buff_df2,ch_buff_full_df2[,c('sciname','area_acres_full')],by='sciname')
CH_buff_AREAS$DIFF = CH_buff_AREAS$area_acres_full-CH_buff_AREAS$area_acres

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Range No Buffer
range_df2 = range_df %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres))
range_full_df2 = range_full_df %>% group_by(sciname) %>% 
  summarize(area_acres_full = sum(area_acres))

Range_AREAS = merge(range_df2,range_full_df2[,c('sciname','area_acres_full')],by='sciname')
Range_AREAS$DIFF = Range_AREAS$area_acres_full-Range_AREAS$area_acres

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Range with Buffer
range_buff_df2 = range_buff_df %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres))
range_buff_full_df2 = range_buff_full_df %>% group_by(sciname) %>% 
  summarize(area_acres_full = sum(area_acres))

Range_buff_AREAS = merge(range_buff_df2,range_buff_full_df2[,c('sciname','area_acres_full')],by='sciname')
Range_buff_AREAS$DIFF = Range_buff_AREAS$area_acres_full-Range_buff_AREAS$area_acres




options(scipen = 999)
```

# Soy Crushing Facilities
```{r}

clark_dir = "C:/Users/MPennino/OneDrive - Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)/Projects/Collaborations/Clark/"


fac_df = read.csv(paste0(clark_dir,'Crushing_Plant_Facilities.csv'))

length(unique(fac_df$Facility_ID)) # 63
length(unique(fac_df$Zip.Code)) # 62


# Map spatial layer 
# fac_s <- st_as_sf(fac_df, coords = c("longitude","latitude"))
# fac_s <- st_set_crs(fac_s, 4201) 
fac_s <- st_as_sf(fac_df, coords = c( "latitude","longitude"), crs = 4201, remove = FALSE)

# Change projection
fac_s <- st_transform(fac_s, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))

# # Checking that the maps overlap (the crs used for converting coordinates can't be 5070 for some reason)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = subset(fac_s,!is.na(Facility_ID)),
          mapping = aes(color=Facility_ID)) +
  geom_sf(data=states_conus,fill=NA,color='black')


# Add 50 mile buffer (80467.2 meters)
fac_b <- st_buffer(fac_s, dist = 80467.2)


```


# Clip AL to Facilities Buffer
* This is the code I am using for generating the AL clipped layer for the analysis
```{r}



#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Clip al_stars raster to just the 63 facility buffer areas

al_stars2 <- st_transform(al_stars, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))
al_r = as(al_stars2, "Raster") # stars to raster

projection(al_stars)
projection(al_r)
projection(fac_b)
res(al_r)

# Reproject to a new CRS
# new_crs <- CRS("+init=epsg:5070")
# al_r2 <- projectRaster(al_r, crs = new_crs)
# projection(al_r2)
# projection(fac_b)

al_r_crop <- crop(al_r, extent(fac_b))
al_r_mask <- mask(al_r_crop, fac_b)

# convert back to stars object
al_stars_clip = st_as_stars(al_r_mask)

st_res(al_stars_clip)
res(al_r_mask)

projection(al_stars_clip)
projection(al_r_mask)
projection(fac_b)

saveRDS(al_stars_clip, file=paste0(al_dir,'AvailableLand23_raster_3acre_Pixels_over15acrePatches_simp_crs5070_63Facil_stars3.rds'))

writeRaster(al_r_mask, paste0(al_dir,"AvailableLand23_raster_3acre_Pixels_over15acrePatches_simp_crs5070_63Facil_raster3.tif"), format = "GTiff", overwrite = TRUE)
```

# Corn Biorefineries
```{r}

library('tidygeocoder')
library(sf)

clark_dir = "C:/Users/MPennino/OneDrive - Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)/Projects/Collaborations/Clark/"


bio = read.csv(paste0(clark_dir,'DART_Active Corn Ethanol Biorefineries.csv'))

# Create Address Field
bio$ADDRESS = paste0(bio$Address.1,", ",bio$City,", ",bio$State.Code)


# Step 1: Geocode the addresses
#geocoded_df <- geocode(bio, address = ADDRESS, method = 'osm') # does work for all addresses
geocoded_df2 <- geocode(bio, address = ADDRESS, method = 'arcgis')

# Remove 10 MIDDLE STREET, AYLMER, CT, which is actually in Canada
geocoded_df2 = geocoded_df2[geocoded_df2$ADDRESS != '10 MIDDLE STREET, AYLMER, CT',]


# Step 2: Convert to sf point object
# WGS84 (EPSG: 4326) is the standard for lat/long coordinates
bio_s <- st_as_sf(geocoded_df2, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Step 3: Save as a Shapefile
st_write(bio_s, paste0(clark_dir,'Spatial/Corn_biorefineries_points.shp'),layer_options = 'OVERWRITE=YES', update = TRUE)




#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Change projection
bio_s <- st_transform(bio_s, CRS("+init=epsg:5070"))

# # Checking that the maps overlap (the crs used for converting coordinates can't be 5070 for some reason)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = subset(bio_s,!is.na(Facility.Name)),
          mapping = aes(color=Facility.Name)) +
    theme(legend.position="none")+
  geom_sf(data=states_conus,fill=NA,color='black')


# Add 50 mile buffer (80467.2 meters)
bio_b <- st_buffer(bio_s, dist = 80467.2)

st_write(bio_b, paste0(clark_dir,'Spatial/Corn_biorefineries_50mi_buffer.shp'),layer_options = 'OVERWRITE=YES', update = TRUE)






```

# Protected Areas (PAD-US)
* https://www.usgs.gov/programs/gap-analysis-project/science/pad-us-data-overview
* Step 1: Generate Shapefile based on PAD categories
* Step 2: created dissolved version of shapefile in ArcPro (code in R is not working) (Dissolve function - no need to select specific dissolve field)
* Step 3: Use Erase tool to remove from the AL shapefile the areas that intersect with protected lands.
* Step 4: Calculate % of PAD lands that intersect with each species CH (see R code parts 1 and 2 below)

# Step1b
* remove if <15 acres based on raster pixels (or <5 pixels in a group)
```{r}

library(terra)

al_r = as(al_stars,"Raster")

#al_terra = rast(al_r) # raster to terra object

#al_terra = rast(al_stars) # convert to terra raster object
class(al_terra)

#clumps <- clump(al_terra) # assigns a unique ID to each connected group of non-NA cells.
clumps <- clump(al_r) # assigns a unique ID to each connected group of non-NA cells.

# Get frequency of each clump ID
clump_freq <- freq(clumps)
clump_freq = as.data.frame(clump_freq)  
# Calculate area for each clump
clump_areas <- data.frame(ID = clump_freq$value, pixel_count = clump_freq$count, Area_Acres = clump_freq$count * 3)

# Filter the clump_areas to find the IDs of clumps that are smaller than your desired threshold.

threshold_area <- 5 * 3 # Example: Remove clumps smaller than 5 pixels at 3 acres pixels
clumps_to_remove <- clump_areas$ID[clump_areas$Area < threshold_area]

# Remove the small clumps from the original raster:

# Create a logical raster where small clumps are TRUE
is_small_clump <- is.element(clumps, clumps_to_remove)

# Set values in the original raster to NA where small clumps are found
r_filtered <- al_r
r_filtered[is_small_clump] <- 0 # Or 0, depending on your needs

al_stars_filt = st_as_stars(r_filtered)

# Save Raster as tif and Stars Object
writeRaster(r_filtered, paste0(CH_dir,"Test/available_land_raster_3acre_Pixels_over15acrePatches2.tif"), format = "GTiff", overwrite = TRUE)

saveRDS(al_stars_filt, file=paste0(al_dir,'AvailableLand23_raster_3acre_Pixels_over15acrePatches.rds'))
saveRDS(clump_freq, file=paste0(al_dir,'AvailableLand23_Clumps_3acrePixels.rds'))
saveRDS(clump_areas, file=paste0(al_dir,'AvailableLand23_Clump_Areas_3acrePixels.rds'))



```

```{r}
#CH_list_r = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Rasters/species_FWS_CH_Buffer_rasters_all_speciesbox_alltouched_v4.rds'))
#CH_list_r = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Rasters/species_FWS_CH_Buffer_rasters_all_speciesbox_alltouched_v2.rds'))
#CH_list_r = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Rasters/Rasters_FWS_Range_speciesbox_alltouched_90m.rds'))
#CH_list_r = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Rasters/Rasters_FWS_CH_3acrePixel.rds'))



length(CH_list_r) # 435 CH, 435 CH buff

# Check Projections
#st_crs(CH_list_r[[1]])

projection(as(al_stars, "Raster"))
projection(as(CH_list_r[[13]], "Raster"))
extent(as(al_stars, "Raster"))
extent(as(CH_list_r[[14]], "Raster"))


rcl3 <- data.frame(is = c(0:2000), becomes = c(NA)) # NA if outside Available land

library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)

numCores <- detectCores()
registerDoParallel(numCores-30) # if use more than 3 cores it often crashes

start_time <- Sys.time()
CH_al_r = foreach(i=1:length(CH_list_r)) %dopar% {
  library(raster)
  library(stars)
  
  CH_stars = CH_list_r[[i]]
  
  # crop full available land to get just extent of Species land
  al_r = as(al_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
  CH_r = as(CH_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
  
  al_crop_r = crop(al_r,extent(CH_r)) 

  # If the al_crop_r raster ends up being smaller than the species raster, need to recrop using al raster
  CH_r = crop(CH_r,extent(al_crop_r)) 

  # convert back to stars object
  al_crop_st = st_as_stars(al_crop_r)
  CH_st = st_as_stars(CH_r)

  # Modify the offset & x/y to get matching dimensions
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$x$offset = st_dimensions(CH_st)$x$offset 
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$y$offset = st_dimensions(CH_st)$y$offset

  # Combine the Rasters
  c = c(al_crop_st, CH_st, along=3)
  al_CH = st_apply(c, 1:2, sum)
  al_CH_r = as(al_CH, "Raster") # stars to raster
  
  # Reclassify (zeros are NA's from Available Land)
  # All positive values also become NA because those are species pixels not on available land
  # only negative values are critical habitat on available land.
  al_CH_r2 = reclassify(al_CH_r,rcl=rcl3)
  
  # Reclassify again (to get raster values back to "CH_ID")
  # >0 = species that overlaps with available land for specific species
  # 0 = available land without species
  al_CH_r2+2000 # a whole number greater than total number of species
}
end_time <- Sys.time(); end_time - start_time
# Time difference of 6.598009 mins (774 species), 4 cores
# Time difference of 7.781774 mins (774 species w/ buffer), 4 cores
# Time difference of 12.28011 mins (435 species w/buff), 3 cores
# Time difference of 11.04486 mins (435 species CH w/buff v3), 3 cores 

# When you're done, clean up the cluster
stopImplicitCluster()
gc()

length(CH_al_r)
```

```{r}
rcl3 <- data.frame(is = c(0:2000), becomes = c(NA)) # NA if outside Available land

library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)


numCores <- detectCores()
registerDoParallel(numCores-30) # use between 2 and 4 clusters

start_time <- Sys.time()
RANGE_al_r = foreach(i=1:length(RANGE_list_r)) %dopar% {
  library(raster)
  library(stars)
  
  RANGE_stars = RANGE_list_r[[i]]
  
  # crop full available land to get just extent of Species land
  al_r = as(al_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
  RANGE_r = as(RANGE_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
  
  al_crop_r = crop(al_r,extent(RANGE_r)) 

  # If the al_crop_r raster ends up being smaller than the species raster, need to recrop using al raster
  RANGE_r = crop(RANGE_r,extent(al_crop_r)) 

  # convert back to stars object
  al_crop_st = st_as_stars(al_crop_r)
  RANGE_st = st_as_stars(RANGE_r)

  # Modify the offset & x/y to get matching dimensions
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$x$offset = st_dimensions(RANGE_st)$x$offset 
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$y$offset = st_dimensions(RANGE_st)$y$offset

  # Combine the Rasters
  c = c(al_crop_st, RANGE_st, along=3)
  al_CH = st_apply(c, 1:2, sum)
  al_RANGE_r = as(al_CH, "Raster") # stars to raster
  
  # Reclassify (zeros are NA's from Available Land)
  # All positive values also become NA because those are species pixels not on available land
  # only negative values are critical habitat on available land.
  al_RANGE_r2 = reclassify(al_RANGE_r,rcl=rcl3)
  
  # Reclassify again (to get raster values back to "CH_ID")
  # >0 = species that overlaps with available land for specific species
  # 0 = available land without species
  al_RANGE_r2+2000 # a whole number greater than total number of species
}
end_time <- Sys.time(); end_time - start_time
# Time difference of 6.598009 mins (774 species), 4 cores
# Time difference of 23.76214 mins (Range 1: 1600 species rows), 3 cores
# Time difference of 17.51035 mins (Range 2a: 1000 species rows), 3 cores
# Time difference of 23.63183 mins (Range 2b: 1515 species rows), 3 cores
# Time difference of 35.37172 mins (Range1 buff: 1000 species rows), 3 cores
# Time difference of 42.65341 mins (Range2 buff: 651 species rows), 2
# Time difference of 50.99649 mins, range2 942 species, 2 cores

# When you're done, clean up the cluster
stopImplicitCluster()
gc()
```

```{r}
  al_r = as(al_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
  CH_r = as(CH_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
  
  #al_crop_r = crop(al_r,extent(CH_r),snap="in") 
  al_crop_r = crop(al_r,extent(CH_r)) 

  # If the al_crop_r raster ends up being smaller than the species raster, need to recrop using al raster
  #CH_r = crop(CH_r,extent(al_crop_r),snap="in") 
  CH_r = crop(CH_r,extent(al_crop_r)) 

  # convert back to stars object
  al_crop_st = st_as_stars(al_crop_r)
  CH_st = st_as_stars(CH_r)

  # Modify the offset & x/y to get matching dimensions
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$x$offset = st_dimensions(CH_st)$x$offset 
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$y$offset = st_dimensions(CH_st)$y$offset

  # Combine the Rasters
  c = c(al_crop_st, CH_st, along=3)
  al_CH = st_apply(c, 1:2, sum)
  al_CH_r = as(al_CH, "Raster") # stars to raster
  
  # Reclassify (zeros are NA's from Available Land)
  # All positive values also become NA because those are species pixels not on available land
  # only negative values are critical habitat on available land.
  al_CH_r2 = reclassify(al_CH_r,rcl=rcl3)
  
  # Reclassify again (to get raster values back to "CH_ID")
  # >0 = species that overlaps with available land for specific species
  # 0 = available land without species
  al_CH_r3[[i]] = al_CH_r2+2000 # a whole number greater than total number of species
}
end_time <- Sys.time(); end_time - start_time
# Time difference of 58.9355 mins, 77 species, NMFW range
# Time difference of 25.61728 mins, 9 species NMFW range buffer

overlay2 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Overlay_NMFS_Range_buffer_on_AL_rasters_speciesbbox_allTouched69to77.rds'))
```

```{r}
      CH_r })
  
  
  ## ERROR HANDLING (if no overlap between rasters)
  # If the al_crop_r raster ends up being smaller than the species raster, need to recrop using al raster
  #CH_r = crop(CH_r,extent(al_crop_r)) 
  CH_r <- tryCatch({ # ERROR HANDLING 
    CH_r = crop(CH_r,extent(al_crop_r)) 
    }, error = function(e) {
      CH_r })
  
  #dim(CH_r)
  #dim(al_crop_r)

  # convert back to stars object
  al_crop_st = st_as_stars(al_crop_r)
  CH_st = st_as_stars(CH_r)
  
  # Modify the offset & x/y to get matching dimensions
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$x$offset = st_dimensions(CH_st)$x$offset 
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$y$offset = st_dimensions(CH_st)$y$offset

  al_crop_st = st_as_stars(al_crop_st) # if need to convert from stars_proxy to stars
  CH_st = st_as_stars(CH_st) # if need to convert from stars_proxy to stars
  
  # Modify the offset & x/y to get matching dimensions (need to redo if stars_proxy issue)
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$x$offset = st_dimensions(CH_st)$x$offset 
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$y$offset = st_dimensions(CH_st)$y$offset

  # Check values of al raster
  # temp = getValues(al_crop_r)
  # temp2 = data.frame(value = temp)
  # temp3 = as.data.frame(temp2[complete.cases(temp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
  # names(temp3)[1]= "value"
  # sum(temp3$value<0) # 916839 pixels
  # sum(temp3$value<0)*3 # 2750517 acres
  
  # make sure values for AL are all either 0 or -2000
  al_crop_st2 = al_crop_st
  al_crop_st2[al_crop_st2 <0 ] <- -2000 
  
  
  # # Check values of al raster
  # temp = getValues(as(al_crop_st2,"Raster"))
  # temp2 = data.frame(value = temp)
  # temp3 = as.data.frame(temp2[complete.cases(temp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
  # names(temp3)[1]= "value"
  # levels(factor(temp3$value))
  # sum(temp3$value<0) # 916839 pixels
  # sum(temp3$value<0)*3 # 2750517 acres
  # 
  # # # Check values of al raster
  # temp = getValues(as(CH_st,"Raster"))
  # temp2 = data.frame(value = temp)
  # temp3 = as.data.frame(temp2[complete.cases(temp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
  # names(temp3)[1]= "value"
  # levels(factor(temp3$value))
  # sum(temp3$value<0) # 916839 pixels
  # sum(temp3$value<0)*3 # 2750517 acres
  
  #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine the Rasters
  ## ERROR HANDLING (if no overlap between rasters & dimensions don't match)
  # If the al_crop_r raster ends up being smaller than the species raster, need to recrop using al raster
  #CH_r = crop(CH_r,extent(al_crop_r)) 
  al_CH_r3 <- tryCatch({ # ERROR HANDLING (in case all same value)
    c = c(al_crop_st2, CH_st, along=3)
    al_CH = st_apply(c, 1:2, sum)
    al_CH_r = as(al_CH, "Raster") # stars to raster
    
    # Reclassify (zeros are NA's from Available Land)
    # All positive values also become NA because those are species pixels not on available land
    # only negative values are critical habitat on available land.
    al_CH_r2 = reclassify(al_CH_r,rcl=rcl3)
    
    # Reclassify again (to get raster values back to "CH_ID")
    # >0 = species that overlaps with available land for specific species
    # 0 = available land without species
    #al_CH_r2+2000 # a whole number greater than total number of species
    al_CH_r3 = al_CH_r2+2000 # used only for manually doing this one species at a time
   
    }, error = function(e) {
      al_CH_r3 <- raster(nrows=10, ncols=10)
      al_CH_r3[] <- 0 # Assign NA to all cells
      al_CH_r3 = raster(al_CH_r3)
      })
  
  # Check values
  # temp = getValues(al_CH_r3)
  # summary(temp)

  # temp3 = as.data.frame(temp2[complete.cases(temp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
  # names(temp3)[1]= "value"
  # levels(factor(temp3$value))
  # sum(temp3$value>0) # 916839 pixels
  # sum(temp3$value>0)*3 # 2750517 acres
  
}

rm(CH_al_r)
gc()
}
```

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3: Simulations
*This section randomly samples the a raster layer with species habitat or range land within available land to and determines the number of times a CH is "hit" or "grabbed" randomly compared to the total available land possible to grab.  This random grab is done X iterations to calculate confidence intervals. 
* The values in the table are in units of pixels (number of 30 acre pixels)

# Sim - CH - Parallel (SPECIES)
* if Sample 3764000 acres with 30 acre grid size, 125467 30 acre pixel
* 267252377 acres of available land total/ 30 acre pixels = 8908413 pixels
```{r}

# Create Table representing number of pixels/ag plots in each of the 3 categories:
# 1. Species land not overlapping with Available land
# 2. Available land not overlapping with species land
# 3. Species land overlapping with available land

sampsize = 125467 # Randomly sample this many 30 acre pixels
iterations = 500
AL_pixels = 8908413 # total available land as 30 acre pixels

#overlay_list = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_speciesbbox.rds'))
#overlay_list = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_speciesbbox_allTouched.rds'))
#overlay_list = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Overlay_CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_speciesbbox_allTouched_v2.rds'))
#overlay_list = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Overlay_CH_FWS_buffer_on_AL_rasters_speciesbbox_allTouched.rds'))
#overlay_list = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Overlay_CH_FWS_buffer_on_AL_rasters_speciesbbox_allTouched_v2.rds'))
#overlay_list = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Overlay_CH_FWS_buffer_on_AL_rasters_speciesbbox_allTouched_v3.rds'))
overlay_list = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Overlay_CH_FWS_buffer_on_AL_rasters_speciesbbox_allTouched_v4.rds'))


# Get raster area of each Species
# CH_list_r = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Rasters/species_FWS_CH_Buffer_rasters_all_speciesbox_alltouched_v2.rds'))
# test = CH_list_r[simResults$SPEC_ID == 371,]
# test_r = as(test,"Raster")
# test_r2 <- test_r == max(getValues(test_r))
# test_r2 <- trim(test_r2, values=FALSE)
# ncell(test_r2) # 5159 pixels


length(overlay_list) # 435 CH

# Create a dataframe to contain the overlay information to use in simulations
tableoverlay = data.frame(SPEC_ID = rep(NA,length(overlay_list)), 
                          #SPEC_no_AL = rep(NA,length(overlay_list)), 
                          SPEC_yes_AL = rep(NA,length(overlay_list)))
for(i in 1:length(overlay_list)){
  temp = getValues(overlay_list[[i]])
  temp2 = data.frame(value = temp)
  temp3 = as.data.frame(temp2[complete.cases(temp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
  names(temp3)[1]= "value"
  tableoverlay$SPEC_ID[i] = i 
  #tableoverlay$SPEC_no_AL[i] = sum(temp3$value==0)
  tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL[i] = sum(temp3$value>0)
}

# Add on Amount of available land not intersected with habitat/watershed
tableoverlay$AL_no_SPEC = AL_pixels - tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL

# Remove species/shed with no intersection
tableoverlay = tableoverlay[tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL>0,]


ID_LIST = unique(data.frame(SPEC_ID = tableoverlay$SPEC_ID))
tableoverlay$samp_SPEC_yes_AL = NA

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create DF with empty columns using a loop for each ID
tableoverlay2 = ID_LIST

for (i in 1:iterations) {
  new_col_name <- paste0("samp_", i) # Create unique column names
  tableoverlay2[[new_col_name]] <- NA 
}

nrow(tableoverlay2) # 220 CH, # 225 CH buff

numCores <- detectCores()
registerDoParallel(numCores-18) #

start_time <- Sys.time()
tableoverlay3 = foreach(i=1:nrow(tableoverlay2)) %dopar% {
  
  DF_spec = tableoverlay2[i,]
  
  for(j in 1:iterations){
  print(paste0('SPEC ',i,' iteration ',j))
   
  temp = c(#rep("SPEC_no_AL",tableoverlay$SPEC_no_AL[i]),
               rep("SPEC_yes_AL",tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL[i]),
              rep("AL_no_SPEC",tableoverlay$AL_no_SPEC[i]))
   random_sample <- sample(temp, size = sampsize,replace=F)
   
   # Counts number of 30 acre pixel cells randomly sampled 
   n_SPEC_yes_AL = sum(random_sample == 'SPEC_yes_AL')
   DF_spec[[paste0("samp_", j)]] = n_SPEC_yes_AL
  }
  tableoverlay3 = DF_spec
}
end_time <- Sys.time(); end_time - start_time
# Time difference of 4.613385 mins, for 105 species and 100 iterations (thus ~23 minutes for 500 iterations ) 
# Time difference of 1.616345 hours, for 462 species and 500 iterations
# Time difference of 1.334559 hours, for 424 species and 500 iterations (CH FWS buff v2) 
# Time difference of 43.05081 mins, 220 species, 500 it (CH FW v2)
# Time difference of 38.30412 mins 195 species, 500 it (CH FWS buff v2)
# Time difference of 47.57876 mins 225 species, 500 it (CH FWS buff v3)
# When you're done, clean up the cluster
stopImplicitCluster()
gc()


CH_SPEC <- do.call(rbind, tableoverlay3)

# saveRDS(tableoverlay3, file=paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_CH_FWS_462species_500iterations.rds'))
# write.csv(CH_SPEC,paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_CH_FWS_462species_500iterations.csv'),row.names=F)

#saveRDS(tableoverlay3, file=paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_CH_FWS_Buffer_500iterations.rds'))
#write.csv(CH_SPEC,paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_CH_FWS_Buffer_500iterations.csv'),row.names=F)


saveRDS(tableoverlay3, file=paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_CH_FWS_Buffer_500iterations_v4.rds')) # with gemetry fixed
write.csv(CH_SPEC,paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_CH_FWS_Buffer_500iterations_v4.csv'),row.names=F)  # with gemetry fixed

# saveRDS(tableoverlay3, file=paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_CH_FWS_500iterations_v2.rds'))
# write.csv(CH_SPEC,paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_CH_FWS_500iterations_v2.csv'),row.names=F)
```

```{r}
5+29*5-5  # i+z*5-5 (i = 1-5, z = part # from 1-97)
```

```{r}
num_files <- length(list.files(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Biorefineries2')))
num_files

tableoverlay_all = list()
start_time <- Sys.time()
# tableoverlay_all = data.frame(SPEC_ID = NA, 
#                           SPEC_yes_AL = NA)
for (z in 1:num_files){

  print(paste0('part ',z,' of ',num_files))

  overlay_part =
  readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Biorefineries2/Overlay_FWS_CH_3acre_CornBiorefine_part',z,'.rds'))

# Create a dataframe to contain the overlay information to use in simulations
tableoverlay = data.frame(SPEC_ID = rep(NA,length(overlay_part)), 
                          SPEC_yes_AL = rep(NA,length(overlay_part)))
for(i in 1:length(overlay_part)){
  temp <- tryCatch({ # ERROR HANDLING (in case all same value)
    getValues(overlay_part[[i]])
    }, error = function(e) {
      NA })
  temp2 = data.frame(value = temp)
  temp3 = as.data.frame(temp2[complete.cases(temp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
  names(temp3)[1]= "value"
  temp3$valueNot0 = ifelse(temp3$value>0,1,0)
  tableoverlay$SPEC_ID[i] = i + z*5-5 # use if there are 5 files in each part (z)
  #tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL[i] = sum(temp3$value>0) # this is summing values, whereas I just need to sub freq of values > 0
  tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL[i] = sum(temp3$valueNot0>0) # this is summing values, whereas I just need to sub freq of values > 0
}
tableoverlay_all[[z]] = tableoverlay
}
end_time <- Sys.time(); end_time - start_time
# Time difference of 52.86665 secs

#tableoverlay_all2 = data.frame(unlist(tableoverlay_all))
tableoverlay_all2 = bind_rows(tableoverlay_all)
tableoverlay_all2$SPEC_ID = seq(1:nrow(tableoverlay_all2))
tableoverlay = tableoverlay_all2
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Add on Amount of available land not intersected with habitat/watershed
tableoverlay$AL_no_SPEC =  AL_pixels- tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL

# Remove species/shed with no intersection
tableoverlay = tableoverlay[tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL>0,]
dim(tableoverlay) # 58

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
tableoverlay2 = ID_LIST

for (i in 1:iterations) {
  new_col_name <- paste0("samp_", i) # Create unique column names
  tableoverlay2[[new_col_name]] <- NA 
}

nrow(tableoverlay2) # 58

numCores <- detectCores()
registerDoParallel(numCores-28) #

start_time <- Sys.time()
tableoverlay3 = foreach(i=1:nrow(tableoverlay2)) %dopar% {
  
  DF_spec = tableoverlay2[i,]
  
  for(j in 1:iterations){
  print(paste0('SPEC ',i,' iteration ',j))
   
  temp = c(#rep("SPEC_no_AL",tableoverlay$SPEC_no_AL[i]),
               rep("SPEC_yes_AL",tableoverlay$SPEC_yes_AL[i]),
              rep("AL_no_SPEC",tableoverlay$AL_no_SPEC[i]))
   random_sample <- sample(temp, size = sampsize,replace=F)
   
   # Counts number of 30 acre pixel cells randomly sampled 
   n_SPEC_yes_AL = sum(random_sample == 'SPEC_yes_AL')
   DF_spec[[paste0("samp_", j)]] = n_SPEC_yes_AL
  }
  tableoverlay3 = DF_spec
}
end_time <- Sys.time(); end_time - start_time

# Time difference of 49.66572 mins, 3 acre, 58 species, 4 cores

# When you're done, clean up the cluster
stopImplicitCluster()
gc()

CH_SPEC <- do.call(rbind, tableoverlay3)
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(CH_SPEC,paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Biorefineries/Sim_tabular_FWS_CH_3acre_500it_2mill_chg_cornBiorefine.csv'),row.names=F)
```

```{r}
# get the pixel areas for species within and extending beyond CONUS
AREA = merge(subset(pixelareas1,select=-c(DIFF)),
             pixelareas2[,c('sciname','area_pixel_acres_full')],
             by='sciname',all.x=T)

# For CH Buff - add in full area for Green sea turtle which can get raster area for

"Chelonia mydas"

# Fill in NAs for the area_pixel_acres_full with the area for species within CONUS

  ifelse(is.na(AREA$area_pixel_acres_full),

AREA$DIFF3= AREA$area_pixel_acres_full-AREA$area_pixel_acres

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize duplicates (sum by each SCI ID to get total hits per species)

temps = merge(CHDF,simResults,by='SPEC_ID')
length(unique(temps$sciname)) # 220 CH buff
temps = subset(temps,select=-c(SPEC_ID,area_acres))

simResults2 = temps %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))


#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean, Median, 90% Confidence Interval of Mean and percentiles


simResults3 = data.frame(sciname = simResults2$sciname,
                         mean=NA, median=NA,
                         CI_95_lower=NA, CI_95_upper=NA, 
                         Percentile_5th=NA, 
                         Percentile_95th = NA)

for(i in 1:nrow(simResults3)){

  simResults3[i,'mean'] = round(mean(temp),1)

  simResults3[i,'CI_95_lower'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[1],1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_upper'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[2],1)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_5th'] =quantile(temp,0.05,na.rm=T)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_95th'] =quantile(temp,0.95,na.rm=T)
  
}

nrow(simResults3) # 220

simResults3$CI_95_upper_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_upper * 3

simResults3$Percentile_95th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_95th * 3

length(unique(ch_name$comname))

                 'overlay_area_acres')]


nrow(simResults4) # 220

  summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres),
            area_acres_full = sum(area_acres_full),
            area_pixel_acres = sum(area_pixel_acres),
            area_pixel_acres_full = sum(area_pixel_acres_full)) %>% unique()

simResults5 = merge(simResults4,ch_area2,by='sciname')

nrow(simResults5) # 220

simResults5$prc_spec_PIXELAREA_intersected =

simResults5$mean_prc_spec_FULL_PIXELAREA_convert =

names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="area_acres")] = "total_spec_area_acres"
```

```{r}
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_lower'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[1],1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_upper'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[2],1)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_5th'] =quantile(temp,0.05,na.rm=T)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_95th'] =quantile(temp,0.95,na.rm=T)
  
}
```

```{r}



sim1a = read.csv(paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_NMFS_CH_line_3acre_500it.csv'))
#info1a = read.csv(paste0(CH_dir,'Overlays/Areas/Overlay_Area_NMFS_CH_line_3acre.csv'))

sim1b = read.csv(paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_NMFS_CH_poly_3acre_500it.csv'))

sim2 = read.csv(paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_NMFS_CH_buff_3acre_500it.csv'))

info3 = read.csv('O:/Public/Pennino/Critical_Habitat/Overlay_Area_NMFS_Range_3acre_wspeciesinfo.csv')

sim4=read.csv('O:/Public/Pennino/Critical_Habitat/Sim_tabular_NMFS_RangeBuff_3acre_500it.csv')
info4 = read.csv('O:/Public/Pennino/Critical_Habitat/Overlay_Area_NMFS_RangeBuff_3acrewspecies.csv')


sim1a. = merge(NMF_CH_line_df[,c('SPEC_ID','sciname','comname')],sim1a,by='SPEC_ID')
sim1b. = merge(NMF_CH_poly_df[,c('SPEC_ID','sciname','comname')],sim1b,by='SPEC_ID')

sim3. = merge(info3[,c('SPEC_ID','sciname','comname')],sim3,by='SPEC_ID')

# Combine duplicates
sim1.. = subset(sim1.,select=-c(SPEC_ID,comname)) %>% 
  group_by(sciname) %>% summarize_all(sum)

  group_by(sciname) %>% summarize_all(sum)

sim4.. = subset(sim4.,select=-c(SPEC_ID,comname)) %>%

# Multiply all simulation columns by 3 to convert from number of pixels to acres

sim3_ = sim3..
sim4_ = sim4..

sim2_[, 2:501] <- sim2_[, 2:501] * 3
sim3_[, 2:501] <- sim3_[, 2:501] * 3
sim4_[, 2:501] <- sim4_[, 2:501] * 3


# Save

write.csv(sim2_,paste0(CH_dir,'Results/All_2025_Simulations/All_500_Sims_acres_impacted_NMFS_CH_Buff_3.74Mchg.csv'),row.names=F)
write.csv(sim3_,paste0(CH_dir,'Results/All_2025_Simulations/All_500_Sims_acres_impacted_NMFS_Range_3.74Mchg.csv'),row.names=F)
```

```{r}
sub_dir = 'O:/Public/Pennino/Critical_Habitat/NMFS_subpops/'
simResults = read.csv(paste0(sub_dir,'Sim_tabular_NMFS_CHsubs_3acre_500it.csv'))
overlayarea = read.csv(paste0(sub_dir,'Overlay_Area_NMFS_CHsubs_3acre_winfo2.csv'))


# Take care of duplicate subpops
overlayarea2 = overlayarea %>% group_by(sciname,subpop) %>%
  summarize(overlay_area_acres = sum(overlay_area_acres),
            basearea_acres = sum(basearea_acres),
            rasterarea_acres = sum(rasterarea_acres),
            baseCONUSarea_acres = sum(baseCONUSarea_acres),
            rasterCONUS_acres = sum(rasterCONUS_acres),
            baselength_m = sum(baselength_m))

# Convert length to area (assuming river is converted to 3 acre pixels)
overlayarea2$basearea_acres_lines = (overlayarea2$baselength_m / 110.1844)*3

# Replace 0 for base area with estimated area from lines (same for clipped and unclipped to CONUS)
overlayarea2$basearea_acres = 
  ifelse(overlayarea2$basearea_acres <1,
         overlayarea2$basearea_acres_lines, overlayarea2$basearea_acres)
overlayarea2$baseCONUSarea_acres = 
  ifelse(overlayarea2$baseCONUSarea_acres <1,
         overlayarea2$basearea_acres_lines, overlayarea2$baseCONUSarea_acres)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize duplicates (sum by each SCI ID to get total hits per species)

temps = merge(overlayarea[,c('SPEC_ID','sciname','subpop')],simResults,by='SPEC_ID')
length(unique(temps$sciname)) # 10 poly, 17 CH buff
temps = subset(temps,select=-c(SPEC_ID))
#temps = subset(temps,select=-c(SPEC_ID,length_km))

simResults2 = temps %>% group_by(sciname,subpop) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))
length(unique(simResults2$subpop)) # 27

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean, Median, 90% Confidence Interval of Mean and percentiles


simResults3 = data.frame(sciname = simResults2$sciname,
                         subpop = simResults2$subpop,
                         mean=NA, median=NA,
                         CI_95_lower=NA, CI_95_upper=NA, 
                         Percentile_5th=NA, 
                         Percentile_95th = NA)

for(i in 1:nrow(simResults3)){
  print(i)
  temp = as.numeric(simResults2[i,-c(1,2)])

  simResults3[i,'mean'] = round(mean(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'median'] = round(median(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_lower'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[1],1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_upper'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[2],1)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_5th'] =quantile(temp,0.05,na.rm=T)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_95th'] =quantile(temp,0.95,na.rm=T)
  
}

nrow(simResults3) # 27

# Convert freq of hits to acres (each pixel = 3 acres)
simResults3$mean_acres_impac = simResults3$mean * 3
simResults3$median_acres_impac = simResults3$median * 3
simResults3$CI_95_lower_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_lower * 3
simResults3$CI_95_upper_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_upper * 3
simResults3$Percentile_5th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_5th * 3
simResults3$Percentile_95th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_95th * 3


# Add on Overlay Areas for each species
simResults3. = merge(simResults3,overlayarea2,
                     by=c('sciname','subpop'),all.x=T)

nrow(simResults3.) # 27

simResults5 = 
  simResults3.[,c('sciname','subpop',
                 'mean_acres_impac','median_acres_impac',
                 'CI_95_lower_acres_impac','CI_95_upper_acres_impac',
                 'Percentile_5th_acres_impac','Percentile_95th_acres_impac',
                 'overlay_area_acres','basearea_acres','rasterarea_acres',
                 'baseCONUSarea_acres','rasterCONUS_acres')]

nrow(simResults5) # 27


simResults5$prc_spec_PIXELAREA_intersected = 
  100*simResults5$overlay_area_acres / simResults5$rasterCONUS_acres
simResults5$mean_prc_spec_PIXELAREA_convert = 
  100*simResults5$mean_acres_impac / simResults5$rasterCONUS_acres
simResults5$mean_prc_spec_FULL_PIXELAREA_convert =
  100*simResults5$mean_acres_impac / simResults5$rasterarea_acres # area_OutsidePixel_acres
simResults5$mean_prc_spec_shapeAreaCONUS_convert = 
  100*simResults5$mean_acres_impac / simResults5$baseCONUSarea_acres
simResults5$mean_prc_spec_shapeAreaFull_convert = 
  100*simResults5$mean_acres_impac / simResults5$basearea_acres



names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="baseCONUSarea_acres")] = "total_spec_area_acres_CONUS"
names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="basearea_acres")] = "total_spec_area_acres_full"
names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="rasterCONUS_acres")] = "total_spec_pixelarea_acres_CONUS"
names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="rasterarea_acres")] = "total_spec_pixelarea_acres_full"
names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="overlay_area_acres")] = "Intersected_Pixels_area_acres"

nrow(simResults5) # 27
options(scipen = 999) 

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# QA Checks:
simResults5$CheckDiffPixArea_ShapeArea = # should all be positive
  simResults5$total_spec_pixelarea_acres_CONUS - simResults5$total_spec_area_acres_CONUS

simResults5$CheckDiffPixAreaFull_ShapeAreaFull =
  simResults5$total_spec_pixelarea_acres_full - simResults5$total_spec_area_acres_full

simResults5$CheckDiff_AreaFull_Area =
  simResults5$total_spec_area_acres_full - simResults5$total_spec_area_acres_CONUS

simResults5$CheckDiff_PixAreaFull_PixArea =
  simResults5$total_spec_pixelarea_acres_full - simResults5$total_spec_pixelarea_acres_CONUS

simResults5$Check_diff1.4landcoversion = # SHould be close to zero
  100*(simResults5$mean_prc_spec_PIXELAREA_convert - 
         simResults5$prc_spec_PIXELAREA_intersected*0.014) /
  simResults5$mean_prc_spec_PIXELAREA_convert

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE


write.csv(simResults5,paste0(CH_dir,'Results/NMFS_Subpops/Results_3acre_NMFS_CH_3.74Mchg_500it_subpop_nobuff.csv'),row.names=F)

```

```{r}
length(unique(temps$sciname)) # 220 CH buff
temps = subset(temps,select=-c(SPEC_ID))

simResults2 = temps %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))


#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean, Median, 90% Confidence Interval of Mean and percentiles


simResults3 = data.frame(sciname = simResults2$sciname,
                         mean=NA, median=NA,
                         CI_95_lower=NA, CI_95_upper=NA, 
                         Percentile_5th=NA, 
                         Percentile_95th = NA)

for(i in 1:nrow(simResults3)){
  print(i)
  temp = as.numeric(simResults2[i,-c(1)])

  simResults3[i,'mean'] = round(mean(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'median'] = round(median(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_lower'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[1],1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_upper'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[2],1)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_5th'] =quantile(temp,0.05,na.rm=T)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_95th'] =quantile(temp,0.95,na.rm=T)
  
}

nrow(simResults3) # 220

# Convert freq of hits to acres (each pixel = 3 acres)
simResults3$mean_acres_impac = simResults3$mean * 3
simResults3$median_acres_impac = simResults3$median * 3
simResults3$CI_95_lower_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_lower * 3
simResults3$CI_95_upper_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_upper * 3
simResults3$Percentile_5th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_5th * 3
simResults3$Percentile_95th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_95th * 3


# Add on Common Name
ch_name = unique(CHDF[,c('sciname','comname')])
length(unique(ch_name$sciname))
length(unique(ch_name$comname))

simResults3 = merge(simResults3,ch_name,by='sciname')

nrow(simResults3) # 220


# Add on Overlay Areas for each species

nrow(simResults3) # 220

simResults4 = 
  simResults3[,c('sciname','comname',
```

```{r}
names(pixelareas2)[which(colnames(pixelareas2)=="area_OutsidePixel_acres")] = "area_pixel_acres_full"


# get the pixel areas for species within and extending beyond CONUS
AREA = merge(subset(pixelareas1,select=-c(DIFF)),
             pixelareas2[,c('sciname','area_pixel_acres_full')],
             by='sciname',all.x=T)

# For CH Buff - add in full area for Green sea turtle which can get raster area for
# Calculate area_pixel_acres_full by seeing how much more the full area is than clipped area
#"Chelonia mydas"
#ch_area2.2$timesmore = ch_area2.2$area_acres_full /ch_area2.2$area_acres
#ch_area2.2$area_pixel_acres_full = ch_area2.2$area_pixel_acres * ch_area2.2$timesmore

# Fill in NAs for the area_pixel_acres_full with the area for species within CONUS
AREA$area_pixel_acres_full = 
  ifelse(is.na(AREA$area_pixel_acres_full),
         AREA$area_pixel_acres,AREA$area_pixel_acres_full)

AREA$DIFF3= AREA$area_pixel_acres_full-AREA$area_pixel_acres

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize duplicates (sum by each SCI ID to get total hits per species)

temps = merge(CHDF,simResults,by='SPEC_ID')
length(unique(temps$sciname)) # 220 CH buff
temps = subset(temps,select=-c(SPEC_ID,area_acres))

simResults2 = temps %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))


#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean, Median, 90% Confidence Interval of Mean and percentiles


simResults3 = data.frame(sciname = simResults2$sciname,
                         mean=NA, median=NA,
                         CI_95_lower=NA, CI_95_upper=NA, 
                         Percentile_5th=NA, 
                         Percentile_95th = NA)

for(i in 1:nrow(simResults3)){
  print(i)
  temp = as.numeric(simResults2[i,-c(1)])

  simResults3[i,'mean'] = round(mean(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'median'] = round(median(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_lower'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[1],1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_upper'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[2],1)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_5th'] =quantile(temp,0.05,na.rm=T)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_95th'] =quantile(temp,0.95,na.rm=T)
  
}

nrow(simResults3) # 220

# Convert freq of hits to acres (each pixel = 3 acres)
simResults3$mean_acres_impac = simResults3$mean * 3
simResults3$median_acres_impac = simResults3$median * 3
simResults3$CI_95_lower_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_lower * 3
simResults3$CI_95_upper_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_upper * 3
simResults3$Percentile_5th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_5th * 3
simResults3$Percentile_95th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_95th * 3


# Add on Common Name
ch_name = unique(CHDF[,c('sciname','comname')])
length(unique(ch_name$sciname))
length(unique(ch_name$comname))

simResults3 = merge(simResults3,ch_name,by='sciname')

nrow(simResults3) # 58


# Add on Overlay Areas for each species
overlayarea2 = merge(CHDF,overlayarea[,c('SPEC_ID','overlay_area_acres')],by='SPEC_ID')
simResults3 = merge(simResults3,overlayarea2[,c('sciname','overlay_area_acres')],by='sciname')

nrow(simResults3) # 58

simResults4 = 
  simResults3[,c('sciname','comname',

                 'CI_95_lower_acres_impac','CI_95_upper_acres_impac',
                 'Percentile_5th_acres_impac','Percentile_95th_acres_impac',
                 'overlay_area_acres')]


nrow(simResults4) # 220

# Add in Area and do calculations
ch_area2 = AREA %>% group_by(sciname) %>% 
  summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres),
            area_acres_full = sum(area_acres_full),
            area_pixel_acres = sum(area_pixel_acres),
            area_pixel_acres_full = sum(area_pixel_acres_full)) %>% unique()

simResults5 = merge(simResults4,ch_area2,by='sciname')

nrow(simResults5) # 58

simResults5$prc_spec_PIXELAREA_intersected = 
  100*simResults5$overlay_area_acres / simResults5$area_pixel_acres
simResults5$mean_prc_spec_PIXELAREA_convert = 
  100*simResults5$mean_acres_impac / simResults5$area_pixel_acres
simResults5$mean_prc_spec_FULL_PIXELAREA_convert =
  100*simResults5$mean_acres_impac / simResults5$area_pixel_acres_full # area_OutsidePixel_acres



names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="area_acres")] = "total_spec_area_acres"
names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="area_acres_full")] = "total_spec_area_acres_full"
```

```{r}
areas_fws_range_nb2$area_pixel_acres_full_nb = areas_fws_range_nb2$area_pixel_acres_full

areas_nmf_ch_nb$area_pixel_acres_nb = areas_nmf_ch_nb$area_pixel_acres
areas_nmf_ch_nb$area_pixel_acres_full_nb = areas_nmf_ch_nb$area_pixel_acres_full

NMFS_rng_nb$total_spec_area_acres_full_nb = NMFS_rng_nb$total_spec_area_acres_full



#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge non-buff areas
areas_fws_ch_nb = merge(areas_fws_ch_nb1[,c('sciname','area_pixel_acres_nb')],
                        areas_fws_ch_nb2[,c('sciname','area_pixel_acres_full_nb')],
                        by='sciname',all.x=T)

areas_fws_range_nb = merge(areas_fws_range_nb1[,c('sciname','area_pixel_acres_nb')],

  ifelse(is.na(areas_fws_ch_nb$area_pixel_acres_full_nb),
```

#**


# Darin Method
* if Sample 3764000 acres with 30 acre grid size, 125467 30 acre pixel
* 267252377 acres of available land total/ 30 acre pixels = 8908413 pixels
```{r}

# The idea is that we have watersheds that have some proportion of available agriculture 
# land that could be converted because of increased need for crops. We know across the 
# entire study area a proportion is going to be converted but we do not know where. 
# This simulaton represents a scenario where watersheds intersect the available
# agland (have an area of land that could be converted). We simulate a 1% 
# (or whatever the number) using a dirichlet distribution (a multivariate beta distributuion).
# across all watersheds a total of 1% land is changed but randomly distributed among them. 

options(scipen = 99999)
#install.packages("extraDistr")
library(extraDistr)
# total ag land to be converted
TotalAg_converted <- 3764000
TotalAg_US <- 267252377

# proportion of available ag land converted in US by Rule
# if we know that across the total study area 1% of the land would change 
# then then 1% of the the total avaliable ag land within each watershed is 
# representitive (i.e. i'm going to apply NRSA weights)
AgChange <- TotalAg_converted/TotalAg_US


# Simulate available ag land within each basin. This would be something that 
# MP could add with the intersect function
# n <- 1000
# AgLandInWs <- runif(n, 1, 100)
# TotLandInWs <- sum(AgLandInWs)
# 
# # create table to store results
# sim.df. <- data.frame(AgLandInWs)

# from Spatial Overlay Results
#test = read.csv(paste0(CH_dir,'Results/tabular_CH_FWS_462species_500iterations.csv'))
sim.areas = tableoverlay # from Code above
sim.areas$AgLandInWs = sim.areas$SPEC_yes_AL*30
AgLandInWs = sim.areas$AgLandInWs
sim.df <- data.frame(AgLandInWs)
  
# simulation proportion of land within the watershed that changes - 
# Construct 50 simulations that reflect the percentage of AgChange within 
# each of the watersheds
sims <- sapply(1:500, simplify = F, function(x) 
  extraDistr::rdirichlet(1, alpha = rep(1, nrow(sim.df))))

# multiply by the AgChange to anticipate the area of land that could change
#LandChange <- lapply(sims, function(x) x * sum(sim.df$AgLandInWs) * AgChange)
LandChange <- lapply(sims, function(x) x * (sim.df$AgLandInWs) * AgChange)

sim.df <- data.frame(sim.df, t(do.call(rbind,LandChange)))

# Correct instances where change exceeds the amount of available ag 
# land within the watershed --- simply calculate the difference between 
# the amount of available agland in the watershed and reallocate among 
# basins that have conversion

for (i in 1:nrow(sim.df)){
  # check if converted land exceeds the mount of land available
  if(any(sim.df$AgLandInWs[i] < sim.df[i,])){
    #  calculate to reallocate the difference
    dif <- sim.df$AgLandInWs[i] - sim.df[i,]
    cols <- which(dif < 0)
    vals <- abs(dif[dif < 0])

    # loop through columns
    for (j in 1:length(cols)){
      #j<-1
      # identify which columns have area that can be converted
      # To be eligible to accept, the amount remaining needs to be greater 
      # than the reallocated total. It is unlikely that a single watershed,
      # could be allocated the entire difference but wanted to prevent 
      # the allocated amount form exceeding the available land
      
      add2these <- sim.df$AgLandInWs - sim.df[,cols[j]]>vals[j]
      vals2add <- extraDistr::rdirichlet(1, alpha = rep(1, sum(add2these)))*vals[j]
      
      # add reallocated values across all watersheds that have avilable agland
      sim.df[add2these, cols[j]] <- t(sim.df[add2these,cols[j]] + vals2add)
      
      #update the original value so that all agland is converted, as necessary
      sim.df[i, cols[j]] <- sim.df[i,"AgLandInWs"]
      
    }
  }  
}


#check simulation

# all simulations convert 1% of the available ag land but are randomly distributed 
# across the watersheds
#head(sim.df)

# Total Land change across all basins equals the total expected change
#colSums(sim.df) 
# the land change does not exceed the amount of available land w/in the watershed  
any(apply(sim.df, 1, function(x) any(x > x["AgLandInWs"])))

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tabular Summaries
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge back on SPEC_ID
sim.R = cbind(sim.areas[,c('SPEC_ID','AgLandInWs')],sim.df)
sim.R = subset(sim.R, select= -c(AgLandInWs))

# Test out why some with large percent
test = merge(sim.R,st_drop_geometry(CH[,c('sciname','comname','SPEC_ID')]),by='SPEC_ID')
test <- test %>% relocate(sciname,comname)

# Add on sciname & 
# Summarize duplicates (sum by each SCI ID to get total hits per species)
temps = merge(CH_df,sim.R,by='SPEC_ID')
length(unique(temps$sciname))
temps = subset(temps,select=-c(SPEC_ID))

simR2 = temps %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))
simR2 = subset(simR2,select=-c(AgLandInWs))


#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean, Median, 90% Confidence Interval of Mean and percentiles


simR3 = data.frame(sciname = simR2$sciname,
                   mean_acres_impac=NA, 
                   median_acres_impac=NA,
                   CI_95_lower_acres_impac=NA, 
                   CI_95_upper_acres_impac=NA, 
                   Percentile_5th_acres_impac=NA,
                   Percentile_95th_acres_impac = NA)

for(i in 1:nrow(simR3)){
  print(i)
  temp = as.numeric(simR2[i,-1])

  simR3[i,'mean_acres_impac'] = round(mean(temp),1)
  simR3[i,'median_acres_impac'] = round(median(temp),1)
  simR3[i,'CI_95_lower_acres_impac'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[1],1)
  simR3[i,'CI_95_upper_acres_impac'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[2],1)
  simR3[i,'Percentile_5th_acres_impac'] =quantile(temp,0.05,na.rm=T)
  simR3[i,'Percentile_95th_acres_impac'] =quantile(temp,0.95,na.rm=T)
  
}

# Convert freq of hits to acres (each pixel = 30 acres)
# simR3$mean_acres_impac = simR3$mean * 30
# simR3$median_acres_impac = simR3$median * 30
# simR3$CI_95_lower_acres_impac = simR3$CI_95_lower * 30
# simR3$CI_95_upper_acres_impac = simR3$CI_95_upper * 30
# simR3$Percentile_5th_acres_impac = simR3$Percentile_5th * 30
# simR3$Percentile_95th_acres_impac = simR3$Percentile_95th * 30


# Add on Common Name
ch_area. = unique(ch_area[,c('sciname','comname')])
length(unique(ch_area.$sciname))
length(unique(ch_area.$comname))

simR3 = merge(simR3,ch_area.,by='sciname')

simR4 = 
  simR3[,c('sciname','comname',
                 'mean_acres_impac','median_acres_impac',
                 'CI_95_lower_acres_impac','CI_95_upper_acres_impac',
                 'Percentile_5th_acres_impac','Percentile_95th_acres_impac')]

# Add in Area and do calculations
ch_area2 = ch_area %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres)) %>% unique()

# If area is < 30 acres, need to change it to 30 because working with minimum of 30 acre pixels
ch_area2$area_acres[ch_area2$area_acres < 30]=30

simR5 = merge(simR4,ch_area2,by='sciname')

simR5$mean_prc_spec_area_convert = 100*simR5$mean_acres / simR5$area_acres
options(scipen = 999)
```

# Table Sheds 
* If sampling 100,000 acres with 30 acre grid size, need to sample for 3333 30 acre pixels
* If sampling 500,000 acres with 30 acre grid size, need to sample for 16667 30 acre pixels
```{r}

interval_ch = 500 # Number of iterations used for species analysis
pixsize_ch = 30 # size of pixel in acres
#sample_n = 16667 # sample size

SHEDS$area = st_area(SHEDS) # creates area in sq meters
SHEDS$area_acres = SHEDS$area * 0.000247105
SHEDS = subset(SHEDS, select= -c(area))

#ch_SPEC = read.csv(paste0(ch_dir,'R_data/indiv_species_CH_NoBuff_DF_30pix_100k_samp_100it.csv'))
#ch_SPEC = read.csv(paste0(ch_dir,'R_data/indiv_species_CH_NoBuff_DF_30pix_500k_samp_500it.csv'))


# Get Frequency of Each Species
ch_SPEC2 = ch_SPEC %>% group_by(SHED_ID) %>% summarize(Freq = n()) %>% unique()


# Merge on Species Info
top_spec = merge(ch_SPEC2,SHEDS[,c("UNIQUE_ID","SHED_ID")],by="SHED_ID",all.x=T)
#top_spec = st_as_sf(top_spec)
#top_spec = st_drop_geometry(top_spec)
top_spec = unique(top_spec)
top_spec = top_spec[order(-top_spec$Freq),]

top_spec$Rank = seq(1:nrow(top_spec))

# move column of interest to first column
top_spec = top_spec %>% relocate(Rank)

# Convert Frequency of times a pixel for a species is sampled to area
top_spec$Freq_per_it = top_spec$Freq/interval_ch

# area a species is sampled on average
top_spec$Spec_Acres = top_spec$Freq_per_it * pixsize_ch # (acres per pixel)

# % a species is hit per iteration (area hit per species / total area converted)
# for species with multiple rows (separate habitats) need to group and sum
SHEDS2 = SHEDS %>% group_by(SHED_ID) %>% summarize(total_spec_acres = sum(area_acres))

top_spec = merge(top_spec,SHEDS2,by='SHED_ID',all.x=T)
top_spec$prc_spec_hit = 100*top_spec$Spec_Acres / (sample_n*pixsize_ch)

# % of species areas selected out of its total critical habitat
top_spec$prc_spec_crit_hab = 100*top_spec$Spec_Acres / top_spec$total_spec_acres 

# Round the output values
top_spec$Freq_per_it = round(top_spec$Freq_per_it,1)
top_spec$Spec_Acres = round(top_spec$Spec_Acres,1)
top_spec$prc_spec_hit = round(top_spec$prc_spec_hit,3)
top_spec$prc_spec_crit_hab = round(top_spec$prc_spec_crit_hab,3)

top_spec = top_spec[,c('SHED_ID','Rank','Freq','Freq_per_it','Spec_Acres',
                       'prc_spec_hit','prc_spec_crit_hab')]

# Rank
top_spec = top_spec[order(-top_spec$Freq),]


write_clip(top_spec)


# save output files
#write.csv(top_spec,paste0(ch_dir,'Output/indiv_species_Table_CONUS_CH_NoBuff_30acre_500k_samp_500it.csv'),row.names=F)
```

```{r}
start_time <- Sys.time()
al_sample_list = list()
for(i in 1:interval) {
  print(i)
  # sampleRandom is without replacement
  r_sample = sampleRandom(al_raster,size=sample_n,na.rm=T,asRaster=T,sp=F)

  al_sample_list[[i]] = r_sample
}

# Time difference of 1.202329 mins, for raster with NAs (thus it would take about 1 hour to run 500 interations)
```

```{r}

shed_dir = "D:/ArcGIS/Collaborations/2025_Critical_Habitat/Rasters/"
sheds_list_r = readRDS(paste0(shed_dir,'Shed_rasters_oregon_1to5_shedbox.rds'))

pixsize1 = 348.4336  # units = meters (348.4336 m for 30 acre grid)
rcl3 <- data.frame(is = c(0:2000), becomes = c(NA)) # NA if outside Available land

library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)



numCores <- detectCores()
registerDoParallel(numCores-29) # if use more than 3 cores it often crashes

#sheds_al_list = list()

start_time <- Sys.time()

sheds_al_r = foreach(k=1:length(sheds_list_r)) %dopar% {
  library(raster)
  library(stars)
  
  shed_stars = sheds_list_r[[k]]
  
  avg_hit = c()
  for (i in 1:length(al_list_r)){ # size of interval
    
    # crop full available land to get just extent of shed
    al_r = al_list_r[[i]]
    shed_r = as(shed_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
    al_crop_r = crop(al_r,extent(shed_r)) 
  
    # If the al_crop_r raster ends up being smaller than the shed raster, need to recrop using al raster
    shed_r = crop(shed_r,extent(al_crop_r)) 
  
    # convert back to stars object
    al_crop_st = st_as_stars(al_crop_r)
    shed_st = st_as_stars(shed_r)
  
    # Modify the offset to get matching dimensions
    st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$x$offset = st_dimensions(shed_st)$x$offset 
    st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$y$offset = st_dimensions(shed_st)$y$offset
    
    # Combine the Rasters
    c = c(al_crop_st, shed_st, along=3)
    al_shed = st_apply(c, 1:2, sum)
    al_shed_r = as(al_shed, "Raster") # stars to raster
    
    # Reclassify (zeros are NA's from Available Land)
    # All positive values also become NA because those are watersheds pixels not on available land
    # only negative values are critical habitat on available land.
    al_shed_r2 = reclassify(al_shed_r,rcl=rcl3)
    
    # Reclassify again (to get raster values back to "SHED_ID")
    # >0 = watershed that overlaps with available land for specific species
    # 0 = available land without watershed
    al_shed_r2 = al_shed_r2+2000 # a whole number greater than total number of watersheds
  
    r.samp2 = data.frame(value = getValues(al_shed_r2))
    r.samp2 = as.data.frame(r.samp2[complete.cases(r.samp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
    names(r.samp2)[1]= "value"
  
    # ERROR HANDLING (if no overlap with available land so only NAs)
    temp <- tryCatch({
      r.samp3 = r.samp2[r.samp2$value !=0,]
      if(length(r.samp3) == 0) {0 } else { r.samp3 }
      }, error = function(e) {
      if(length(!is.na(r.samp2)) == 0) {0 } else { r.samp3=r.samp2[r.samp2$value !=0,] }
      })

    #ch_list = c(ch_list,temp)
    
    # capture number of species hit per iteration
    avg_hit[i] = length(r.samp3)
    
  }
  avg_hit
}
end_time <- Sys.time(); end_time - start_time
# Time difference of 1.873879 mins, 3 cores, for 5 watersheds & 10 iterations (~ 18 min per 500 iterations per shed or )
# Time difference of 1.846868 mins with 4 cores. 

# When you're done, clean up the cluster
stopImplicitCluster()
gc()

saveRDS(sheds_al_r, file=paste0(shed_dir,'Sheds_on_Al_rasters_oregon_1to5_fast.rds'))



```

```{r}

sum_hits1 = read.csv(paste0(ch_dir,'R_data/indiv_species_CH_Buff_AVG_30pix_500k_samp_500it_part1.csv'))

# Convert all values to 1 or zero to signify if that species was hit that iteration
sum_hits2 = as.data.frame(ifelse(sum_hits > 0, 1, 0))

# Calculate the total number of unique species selected per iteration (Rowsums)
sum_hits2$Total_Species_Hit = rowSums(sum_hits2[1:ncol(sum_hits2)])

# Average number of Unique Species Impacted per iteration
avg_uniq_spec_imp = mean(sum_hits2$Total_Species_Hit)

#^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

sum_hits3 = as.data.frame(t(sum_hits2_))
sum_hits3$sum_all_iterations = rowSums(sum_hits3[1:ncol(sum_hits3)])
sum_hits3$pct_all_iterations = 100*sum_hits3$sum_all_iterations/interval_range

# Number of Species Hit every time
num_hit100prc = sum(sum_hits3$pct_all_iterations == 100) 

# Number of species hit in 5% of iterations
num_hit5prc = sum(sum_hits3$pct_all_iterations >= 5) # 16 for 100k, 28 for 500K

# Number of species hit in 25% of iterations
num_hit25prc = sum(sum_hits3$pct_all_iterations >= 25) # 16 for 100k, 28 for 500K

# Number of species hit in 50% of iterations
num_hit50prc = sum(sum_hits3$pct_all_iterations >= 50) # 13 for 100K, 21 for 500K

# Number of species hit in 75% of iterations
num_hit75prc = sum(sum_hits3$pct_all_iterations >= 75) # 9 for 100K, 19 for 500K

# Number of species affected in at least 1 out of all iterations
num_spec_affec_once = sum(sum_hits3$sum_all_iterations >0)


#^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
# Table Compiling this info
avg_table = data.frame(num_spec_affec_once=num_spec_affec_once,
                       num_hit5prc=num_hit5prc,

                       num_hit75prc=num_hit75prc,
                       num_hit100prc=num_hit100prc,
                       avg_uniq_spec_imp=avg_uniq_spec_imp)
                       
write_clip(avg_table)
```

# Loop: Individual Species CH
* 348.4336 m pixel = 30 acre grid
* If sampling 100,000 acres with 30 acre grid size, need to sample for 3333 30 acre pixels
* If sampling 500,000 acres with 30 acre grid size, need to sample for 16667 30 acre pixels
```{r}

sample_n = 16667
interval = 500
inital_samp = 6*sample_n # 40000 if 100k sample or 200000 if 500k sample


species_list_full = readRDS(paste0(ch_dir, 'Rasters/species_rasters_ch_list_all.rds'))
#species_list_full = readRDS(paste0(ch_dir, 'Rasters/species_rasters_ch_list_part1.rds'))
#species_list_full = readRDS(paste0(ch_dir, 'Rasters/species_rasters_ch_list_part2.rds'))


# length(species_list_r2)
# species_list_r = species_list_r2[1:10]
# rm(species_list_r2)
# length(species_list_r) 


start_time1 <- Sys.time()
ch_list_all = list()
avg_hit_list = list()
#avg_hit_all = c()

for(k in 1:length(species_list_full)){
  
  start_time2 <- Sys.time()
  ch_list = c()
  avg_hit = c()
  for(i in 1:interval) {
    # Need to oversample the raster because it selects NAs
    # Then I can sample down the output of this to get the correct number.
    # sampleRandom is without replacement
    r_sample = sampleRandom(species_list_full[[k]],size=inital_samp,na.rm=T,asRaster=F,sp=F)
    r_sample2 = data.frame(value = r_sample)
    # by default replace = FALSE ()
    r.samp <- r_sample2[sample( 1:dim(r_sample2)[1], sample_n),] # sampling down to sample_n
    r.samp2 = data.frame(value = r.samp)
    r.samp3 = r.samp2[r.samp2$value !=0,]
    
    if(length(r.samp3) == 0) {temp=0 } else { temp = r.samp3 }
    
    ch_list = c(ch_list,temp)
    
    # capture number of species hit per iteration
    avg_hit[i] = length(r.samp3)
    
  }
  
  ch_list_all[[k]] = ch_list
  avg_hit_list[[k]] = avg_hit
  #avg_hit_all[k] = mean(avg_hit,na.rm=T)
  
end_time2 <- Sys.time(); end_time2 - start_time2

}
end_time1 <- Sys.time(); end_time1 - start_time1
# Time difference of 11.21905 mins, 30 iterations, 10 species, 100K scenario
# Time difference of 3.21905 mins, 100 iterations, 120 species, 100K scenario
# Time difference of 1.428867 days, 500 iterations, 120 species, 500K scenario

#num_hits_list_all = unlist(avg_hit_list)

# Save as Dataframe
ch_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = unlist(ch_list_all))
# Remove Zeros
ch_SPEC = ch_SPEC[ch_SPEC$Spec_code != 0,]
ch_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = ch_SPEC)

# Each Column is a species and each row is an iteration
sum_hits = as.data.frame(do.call(cbind,avg_hit_list))
```

```{r}
#CH_list_r = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'Rasters/species_FWS_CH_rasters_all_speciesbox.rds'))

library(stars)

start_time <- Sys.time()
for(i in 1:length(RANGE_list_r1)){
  print(i)
  
  RANGE_stars = RANGE_list_r1[[i]]
  
  # crop full available land to get just extent of Species land
  al_r = as(al_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
  RANGE_r = as(RANGE_stars, "Raster") # stars to raster
  
  al_crop_r = crop(al_r,extent(RANGE_r)) 

  # If the al_crop_r raster ends up being smaller than the species raster, need to recrop using al raster
  RANGE_r = crop(RANGE_r,extent(al_crop_r)) 

  # convert back to stars object
  al_crop_st = st_as_stars(al_crop_r)
  RANGE_st = st_as_stars(RANGE_r)

  # Modify the offset & x/y to get matching dimensions
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$x$offset = st_dimensions(RANGE_st)$x$offset 
  st_dimensions(al_crop_st)$y$offset = st_dimensions(RANGE_st)$y$offset

  # Combine the Rasters
  c = c(al_crop_st, RANGE_st, along=3)
  al_CH = st_apply(c, 1:2, sum)
  al_RANGE_r = as(al_CH, "Raster") # stars to raster
  
  # Reclassify (zeros are NA's from Available Land)
  # All positive values also become NA because those are species pixels not on available land
  # only negative values are critical habitat on available land.
  al_RANGE_r2 = reclassify(al_RANGE_r,rcl=rcl3)
  
  # Reclassify again (to get raster values back to "CH_ID")
  # >0 = species that overlaps with available land for specific species
  # 0 = available land without species
  RANGE_al_r[[i]] = al_RANGE_r2+2000 # a whole number greater than total number of species
}
end_time <- Sys.time(); end_time - start_time
```

```{r}
  # 0 = available land without critical habitat
  al_shed_r2+2000 # a whole number greater than total number of watersheds
}
```

# Original Simulation (Parallel)
* 348.4336 m pixel = 30 acre grid
* 267252377 acres of available land total/ 30 acre pixels = 8908413 pixels
* if Sample 3764000 acres with 30 acre grid size, 125467 30 acre pixel
```{r}

library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)

sample_n = 125467
interval = 500
inital_samp = 6*sample_n # 40000 if 100k sample or 200000 if 500k sample

#CH_al_r1 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_CONUS_1to5.rds'))
#CH_al_r2 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_CONUS_6to10.rds'))
CH_al_r1 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_CONUS_1to5_allTouched.rds'))
CH_al_r2 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_CONUS_6to10_allTouched.rds'))

species_list = CH_al_r2
#species_list_part. = c(CH_al_r1,CH_al_r2)


#PARTS = list(c(1:5),c(6:10)) 

#start_time1 <- Sys.time()

# full_DF = list()
# full_AVG = list()
#
# for (z in 1:length(PARTS)){
#     library(raster)
# 
#   print(z)
#   start_time2 <- Sys.time()
# 
#   species_list_part = species_list_part.[PARTS[[z]]]
# 
# length(species_list_part)

numCores <- detectCores()
registerDoParallel(numCores-26) 

start_time1 <- Sys.time()

combo_list = foreach(k=1:5) %dopar% {
  library(raster)
  species = species_list[[k]]
  #species = result

  ch_list_all = list()
  avg_hit_list = list()
  ch_list = c()
  avg_hit = c()
  for(i in 1:interval) {
    print(i)
    # Need to oversample the raster because it selects NAs
    # Then I can sample down the output of this to get the correct number.
    # sampleRandom is without replacement
    
    # ERROR HANDLING (in case only NAs in raster)
    r_sample <- tryCatch({
      ## sampleRandom is without replacement
      sampleRandom(species,size=inital_samp,na.rm=T,asRaster=F,sp=F)
      }, error = function(e) {
        rep(NA, ncell(species))
      }
      )
    
    r_sample2 = data.frame(value = r_sample)
    # by default replace = FALSE ()
    r.samp <- r_sample2[sample( 1:dim(r_sample2)[1], sample_n),] # sampling down to sample_n
    #r.samp2 = data.frame(value = r.samp)
    #r.samp3 = r.samp2[r.samp2$value !=0,]
    
    #if(length(r.samp3) == 0) {temp=0 } else { temp = r.samp3 }
    
    r.samp2 = as.data.frame(r.samp2[complete.cases(r.samp2[,c("value")]),]) # keeps all rows without NA in specified column
    names(r.samp2)[1]= "value"
  
    # ERROR HANDLING
    temp <- tryCatch({
      r.samp3 = r.samp2[r.samp2$value !=0,]
      if(length(r.samp3) == 0) {0 } else { r.samp3 }
      }, error = function(e) {
      if(length(!is.na(r.samp2)) == 0) {0 } else { r.samp3=r.samp2[r.samp2$value !=0,] }
      })

    ch_list = c(ch_list,temp)
    
    # capture number of species hit per iteration
    avg_hit[i] = length(r.samp3)
    
  }
  
  ch_list_all[[k]] = ch_list
  avg_hit_list[[k]] = avg_hit
  
  # list of lists for the final output 
  list(ch_list_all,avg_hit_list)
}
end_time1 <- Sys.time(); end_time1 - start_time1
# Time difference of 2.126156 mins for 2 species
# Time difference of 4.744192 mins for 5 species
# Time difference of 37.32075 mins for 5 species, 500 iterations
stopImplicitCluster()
gc()

#***************************************************************************
# COMPILE
temp1 = c()
temp2 = list()
for(y in 1:length(combo_list)){
  temp1 = c(temp1,unlist(combo_list[[y]][[1]]))
  temp2[[y]] = combo_list[[y]][[2]][[y]]
}
ch_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = temp1)
ch_SPEC = ch_SPEC[ch_SPEC$Spec_code != 0,] # Remove Zeros
ch_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = ch_SPEC)
#ch_SPEC2 = ch_SPEC %>% group_by(Spec_code) %>% summarize(Freq = n())
  
# Each Column is a species and each row is an iteration
sum_hits = as.data.frame(do.call(cbind,temp2))
#***************************************************************************
end_time2 <- Sys.time()
print(end_time2 - start_time2)

full_DF[[z]] = ch_SPEC
full_AVG[[z]] = sum_hits

#} # end of loop for list subsets
#end_time1 <- Sys.time(); end_time1 - start_time1
# Time difference of 1.318352 hours, 6 cores, 100 iter, 62 spec, 500k (1.275825 min per spec)


# Save as Dataframe
Range_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = unlist(full_DF))

# Remove Zeros
Range_SPEC = Range_SPEC[Range_SPEC$Spec_code != 0,]
Range_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = Range_SPEC)
Range_SPEC2 = Range_SPEC %>% group_by(Spec_code) %>% summarize(Freq = n()) %>% unique()

# Each Column is a species and each row is an iteration
SUM_hits = as.data.frame(do.call(cbind,full_AVG))


write.csv(Range_SPEC,paste0(ch_dir,'R_data/indiv_species_Range_Buff_DF_30pix_500k_samp_100it_part1.csv'),row.names=F)
write.csv(SUM_hits,paste0(CH_dir,'Results/original_indiv_species_SUM_hits_500it_5to10.csv'),row.names=F)


gc()

```

```{r}

library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)

sample_n = 125467
interval = 500
inital_samp = 6*sample_n # 40000 if 100k sample or 200000 if 500k sample

#CH_al_r1 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_CONUS_1to5.rds'))
#CH_al_r2 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_CONUS_6to10.rds'))
CH_al_r1 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_CONUS_1to5_allTouched.rds'))
CH_al_r2 = readRDS(paste0(CH_dir,'CH_FWS_on_AL_rasters_CONUS_6to10_allTouched.rds'))

species_list_part. = c(CH_al_r1,CH_al_r2)


PARTS = list(c(1:5),c(6:10)) 

start_time1 <- Sys.time()

full_DF = list()
full_AVG = list()

for (z in 1:length(PARTS)){
    library(raster)

  print(z)
  start_time2 <- Sys.time()

  species_list_part = species_list_part.[PARTS[[z]]]

length(species_list_part)

numCores <- detectCores()
registerDoParallel(numCores-26) 

combo_list = foreach(k=1:length(species_list_part)) %dopar% {
  library(raster)

  ch_list_all = list()
  avg_hit_list = list()
  ch_list = c()
  avg_hit = c()
  for(i in 1:interval) {
    # Need to oversample the raster because it selects NAs
    # Then I can sample down the output of this to get the correct number.
    # sampleRandom is without replacement
    
    # ERROR HANDLING (in case only NAs in raster)
    r_sample <- tryCatch({
      ## sampleRandom is without replacement
      sampleRandom(species_list_part[[k]],size=inital_samp,na.rm=T,asRaster=F,sp=F)
      }, error = function(e) {
        rep(NA, ncell(species_list_part[[k]]))
      }
      )
    
    r_sample2 = data.frame(value = r_sample)
    # by default replace = FALSE ()
    r.samp <- r_sample2[sample( 1:dim(r_sample2)[1], sample_n),] # sampling down to sample_n
    r.samp2 = data.frame(value = r.samp)
    r.samp3 = r.samp2[r.samp2$value !=0,]
    
    if(length(r.samp3) == 0) {temp=0 } else { temp = r.samp3 }
    
    ch_list = c(ch_list,temp)
    
    # capture number of species hit per iteration
    avg_hit[i] = length(r.samp3)
  }
  
  ch_list_all[[k]] = ch_list
  avg_hit_list[[k]] = avg_hit
  
  # list of lists for the final output 
  list(ch_list_all,avg_hit_list)
}

stopImplicitCluster()
gc()

#***************************************************************************
# COMPILE
temp1 = c()
temp2 = list()
for(y in 1:length(combo_list)){
  temp1 = c(temp1,unlist(combo_list[[y]][[1]]))
  temp2[[y]] = combo_list[[y]][[2]][[y]]
}
ch_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = temp1)
ch_SPEC = ch_SPEC[ch_SPEC$Spec_code != 0,] # Remove Zeros
ch_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = ch_SPEC)
#ch_SPEC2 = ch_SPEC %>% group_by(Spec_code) %>% summarize(Freq = n())
  
# Each Column is a species and each row is an iteration
sum_hits = as.data.frame(do.call(cbind,temp2))
#***************************************************************************
end_time2 <- Sys.time()
print(end_time2 - start_time2)

full_DF[[z]] = ch_SPEC
full_AVG[[z]] = sum_hits

} # end of loop for list subsets
end_time1 <- Sys.time(); end_time1 - start_time1
# Time difference of 1.318352 hours, 6 cores, 100 iter, 62 spec, 500k (1.275825 min per spec)


# Save as Dataframe
Range_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = unlist(full_DF))

# Remove Zeros
Range_SPEC = Range_SPEC[Range_SPEC$Spec_code != 0,]
Range_SPEC = data.frame(Spec_code = Range_SPEC)
Range_SPEC2 = Range_SPEC %>% group_by(Spec_code) %>% summarize(Freq = n()) %>% unique()

# Each Column is a species and each row is an iteration
SUM_hits = as.data.frame(do.call(cbind,full_AVG))


write.csv(Range_SPEC,paste0(ch_dir,'R_data/indiv_species_Range_Buff_DF_30pix_500k_samp_100it_part1.csv'),row.names=F)
```
