```{r}


#simResults = read.csv(paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_FWS_CH_Top20_3acre_500it.csv'))

simResults = read.csv(paste0(CH_dir,'Simulations/Sim_tabular_FWS_CH_3acre_500it.csv'))




#()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()
CH = ch_df # ch_df, range20
AREA = ch_df # ch_df, pixelareas
#()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()()

names(CH)[which(colnames(CH)=="SCINAME")] = "sciname"
names(CH)[which(colnames(CH)=="COMNAME")] = "comname"
CH$SPEC_ID = seq(1:nrow(CH))
CH = st_drop_geometry(CH[,c('SPEC_ID','sciname','comname','area_acres')])

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize duplicates (sum by each SCI ID to get total hits per species)

temps = merge(CH,simResults,by='SPEC_ID')
length(unique(temps$sciname))
temps = subset(temps,select=-c(SPEC_ID,area_acres))

simResults2 = temps %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))


#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean, Median, 90% Confidence Interval of Mean and percentiles


simResults3 = data.frame(sciname = simResults2$sciname,
                         mean=NA, median=NA,
                         CI_95_lower=NA, CI_95_upper=NA, 
                         Percentile_5th=NA, 
                         Percentile_95th = NA)

for(i in 1:nrow(simResults3)){
  print(i)
  temp = as.numeric(simResults2[i,-1])

  simResults3[i,'mean'] = round(mean(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'median'] = round(median(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_lower'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[1],1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_upper'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[2],1)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_5th'] =quantile(temp,0.05,na.rm=T)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_95th'] =quantile(temp,0.95,na.rm=T)
  
}

# Convert freq of hits to acres (each pixel = 30 acres)
simResults3$mean_acres_impac = simResults3$mean * 30
simResults3$median_acres_impac = simResults3$median * 30
simResults3$CI_95_lower_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_lower * 30
simResults3$CI_95_upper_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_upper * 30
simResults3$Percentile_5th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_5th * 30
simResults3$Percentile_95th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_95th * 30


# Add on Common Name
ch_name = unique(CH[,c('sciname','comname')])
length(unique(ch_name$sciname))
length(unique(ch_name$comname))

simResults3 = merge(simResults3,ch_name,by='sciname')

  simResults3[,c('sciname','comname',
                 'mean_acres_impac','median_acres_impac',
                 'CI_95_lower_acres_impac','CI_95_upper_acres_impac',
                 'Percentile_5th_acres_impac','Percentile_95th_acres_impac')]

# Add in Area and do calculations

  summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres)
            #,area_pixel_acres = sum(area_pixel_acres)
            ) %>% unique()

simResults5 = merge(simResults4,ch_area2,by='sciname')
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
length(unique(ch_name$comname))
```

```{r}
length(unique(ch_name$sciname))
length(unique(ch_name$comname))
```

```{r}
simResults4 = 
  simResults3[,c('sciname','comname',
                 'mean_acres_impac','median_acres_impac',
                 'CI_95_lower_acres_impac','CI_95_upper_acres_impac',
                 'Percentile_5th_acres_impac','Percentile_95th_acres_impac')]

# Add in Area and do calculations
ch_area2 = AREA %>% group_by(sciname) %>% 
  summarize(area_acres = sum(area_acres),area_pixel_acres = sum(area_pixel_acres)) %>% unique()

# To deal with small habit areas, need to make minimum habitat area be 30 acreas
#simResults5$area_acres[simResults5$area_acres <30]=30


simResults5$mean_prc_spec_area_convert = 
  100*simResults5$mean_acres_impac / simResults5$area_acres
simResults5$mean_prc_spec_pixelarea_convert = 
  100*simResults5$mean_acres_impac / simResults5$area_pixel_acres

names(simResults5)[which(colnames(simResults5)=="area_acres")] = "total_spec_area_acres"
```

```{r}
#AREA$area_acres  = AREA$area_pixel_acres



#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize duplicates (sum by each SCI ID to get total hits per species)

temps = merge(RANGE,simResults,by='SPEC_ID')
length(unique(temps$sciname))
temps = subset(temps,select=-c(SPEC_ID,area_acres))

simResults2 = temps %>% group_by(sciname) %>% summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))


#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mean, Median, 90% Confidence Interval of Mean and percentiles


simResults3 = data.frame(sciname = simResults2$sciname,
                         mean=NA, median=NA,
                         CI_95_lower=NA, CI_95_upper=NA, 
                         Percentile_5th=NA, 
                         Percentile_95th = NA)

for(i in 1:nrow(simResults3)){
  print(i)
  temp = as.numeric(simResults2[i,-1])

  simResults3[i,'mean'] = round(mean(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'median'] = round(median(temp),1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_lower'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[1],1)
  simResults3[i,'CI_95_upper'] = round(t.test(temp, conf.level = 0.90)$conf.int[2],1)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_5th'] =quantile(temp,0.05,na.rm=T)
  simResults3[i,'Percentile_95th'] =quantile(temp,0.95,na.rm=T)
  
}

# Convert freq of hits to acres (each pixel = 30 acres)
simResults3$mean_acres_impac = simResults3$mean * 30
simResults3$median_acres_impac = simResults3$median * 30
simResults3$CI_95_lower_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_lower * 30
simResults3$CI_95_upper_acres_impac = simResults3$CI_95_upper * 30
simResults3$Percentile_5th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_5th * 30
simResults3$Percentile_95th_acres_impac = simResults3$Percentile_95th * 30


# Add on Common Name

length(unique(range_name$comname))
```
